question: Which biosphere of Southern Andhra Pradesh is home to many endemic species including the famous Red Sanders and Slender Loris?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Seshachalam**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Seshachalam** biosphere in Southern Andhra Pradesh is recognized for its rich biodiversity and is home to many endemic species.
 
• This region is particularly famous for the **Red Sanders** (Pterocarpus santalinus), a valuable and rare tree species known for its distinctive red wood.
 
• Another notable species found here is the **Slender Loris** (Loris tardigradus), a small, nocturnal primate that inhabits this unique ecosystem.
 
• The Seshachalam biosphere plays a crucial role in the conservation of these species and their habitats.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Seshachalam Hills** were designated as a biosphere reserve in **2010** by the Government of India.
 
• The biosphere reserve covers parts of the **Chittoor** and **Kadapa** districts in Andhra Pradesh.
 
• It is part of the Eastern Ghats, which are characterized by their rugged terrain and diverse flora and fauna.
 
• Conservation efforts in this region are aimed at protecting the biodiversity and promoting sustainable development for the local communities.
